business_process: 24x7 alarm monitoring and emergency response (CT-C, CT-M)
description: Receive BAS alarms from 7 county and city buildings, acknowledge them, diagnose remotely, and send a technician; after-hours response for HVAC, server-room cooling, and door alarms
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract service levels: critical alarms acknowledged within 1 hour and a technician on site within 4 hours, 24x7. Occupant and equipment safety (cooling failures in county server and records rooms; Florida heat). Missed critical alarms are reported to the customer and count against renewal
manual_workaround: County security guards and city staff call the on-call phone directly from a printed contact card; the county Building Engineer watches the local BAS workstation on weekdays; on-call technician drives a site patrol of critical equipment if monitoring is down overnight
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-06 (on-call phone and laptops)
dependent_third_parties: BAS monitoring vendor; cellular carrier; county and city networks that carry the gateway tunnels
dependent_people_or_facilities: On-call technician (rotation of 3); Lead Controls Technician; owner as backup

description: Add and remove cardholders, change door schedules, answer lockdown and unlock requests, and investigate door alarms for the 4 county buildings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Emergency lockdown or unlock within 15 minutes of a county request; badge removals within 4 business hours. Door controllers keep enforcing the last cardholder list offline, so entry keeps working, but no change can be pushed. A removed badge that cannot be revoked is a physical security exposure
manual_workaround: Local lockdown push buttons at the administration building security desk work without the cloud. At the 2 libraries and the parks operations building, county staff lock doors by key and post a guard. Lost badges are reported to guards until the revocation can be pushed
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-06; SYS-04 (county requests by email)
dependent_third_parties: Access control and video vendor; county network at each building; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Security Systems Technician; owner as backup; county security staff

business_process: BAS operation and preventive maintenance (CT-C, CT-M)
description: Daily schedule and setpoint changes, comfort calls, trend review, programming changes, and preventive maintenance of controls at 7 buildings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Field controllers keep running their last programs and schedules, so buildings operate; comfort complaints and preventive maintenance can wait about 2 days. Program changes made since the last backup would be lost
manual_workaround: Technicians work locally at each building controller with a laptop; city systems are reached through the city VPN (SYS-10), which does not depend on SYS-02
dependent_third_parties: BAS monitoring vendor; CMMS vendor; city IT (VPN)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Lead Controls Technician; Controls Technician; Building Engineer

description: Programming changes, troubleshooting, and sequence checks at the federal building, on the GSA-furnished workstation, from work orders sent by the prime
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The subcontract requires response within 1 business day. Work on GSA's BAS uses GSA equipment, so the company needs only its 2 PIV holders and a way to receive work orders (FCI)
manual_workaround: The prime phones in work orders; work is recorded on paper and entered in the CMMS later
dependent_systems: SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; GSA-furnished workstation (SYS-11, GSA-owned)
dependent_third_parties: Prime contractor; GSA (PIV cards and BSN access)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Controls Technician and Lead Controls Technician (the 2 PIV holders)

description: Take calls and emails from customers, create and assign CMMS work orders, track service levels, order parts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: All field work flows through dispatch; one day without dispatch delays every customer and hides service-level clocks
manual_workaround: Paper work order log and phone dispatch from the printed contact list; office line forwarded to the Service Coordinator's company phone
dependent_third_parties: CMMS vendor; productivity suite vendor; internet provider; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Service Coordinator; Office and Compliance Manager as backup; office suite

business_process: Video retrieval and export for county requests
description: Find and export entrance video for county security, HR, or law enforcement requests through the county
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Video stays in the vendor cloud for 30 days, so a few days of delay loses nothing unless an outage exceeds the retention window. Requests come through the county, which decides on release
manual_workaround: County security staff view live video at the cameras' local display where available; exports wait until the service returns

business_process: Engineering records: controller programs, door schedules, and drawings
description: Keep current copies of controller programs, gateway configurations, SYS-01 and SYS-02 configuration exports, door hardware schedules, and building drawings (including CT-F CUI drawings)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A failed controller cannot be reprogrammed without its program; rebuilding programs by hand takes days per building. The RPO of 24 hours is the target; today the copies exist only on technician laptops and the real recovery point is unknown
manual_workaround: Ask the city or county for any copies they hold; rebuild critical sequences from drawings and point lists; vendor support for SYS-01 and SYS-02 configuration
dependent_third_parties: MSP (laptops and suite backup); backup service; customers (copies they hold)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Lead Controls Technician; Controls Technician; Security Systems Technician

business_process: Billing, payroll, purchasing, and contract administration
description: Monthly invoices to the county, city, and prime; biweekly payroll through the payroll service; supplier payments; contract and insurance records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices are monthly and payroll is biweekly; a cash reserve covers about 45 days of expenses. Payroll is the hard date
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; invoices sent late with the next cycle
dependent_third_parties: Payroll service; bank; productivity suite vendor
